title: Parker Pipeline Dashboard
description: Searchable archive of Parker's Trump supporter debate livestreams

utterances.title: Transcript
utterances.description: Every utterance with speaker tags and timestamps

keyword_mentions.title: Keyword Mention Count
keyword_mentions.description: Count how many times a keyword appears, broken down by speaker
keyword_mentions.sql: SELECT speaker, COUNT(*) as utterances, SUM(length(text) - length(replace(lower(text), lower(:keyword), '')))/length(:keyword) as total_mentions FROM utterances WHERE lower(text) LIKE '%' || lower(:keyword) || '%' GROUP BY speaker ORDER BY total_mentions DESC

topic_heatmap.title: Topic Mentions by Video
topic_heatmap.description: Count topic keyword mentions per video
topic_heatmap.sql: SELECT v.title, v.video_id, SUM(CASE WHEN lower(u.text) LIKE '%economy%' OR lower(u.text) LIKE '%tariff%' OR lower(u.text) LIKE '%inflation%' OR lower(u.text) LIKE '%tax%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as economy, SUM(CASE WHEN lower(u.text) LIKE '%immigra%' OR lower(u.text) LIKE '%border%' OR lower(u.text) LIKE '%deport%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as immigration, SUM(CASE WHEN lower(u.text) LIKE '%abort%' OR lower(u.text) LIKE '%trans %' OR lower(u.text) LIKE '%gender%' OR lower(u.text) LIKE '%gun %' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as social_issues, SUM(CASE WHEN lower(u.text) LIKE '%epstein%' OR lower(u.text) LIKE '%deep state%' OR lower(u.text) LIKE '%qanon%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as conspiracy, SUM(CASE WHEN lower(u.text) LIKE '%climate%' OR lower(u.text) LIKE '%environment%' OR lower(u.text) LIKE '%energy%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as environment FROM utterances u JOIN videos v ON u.video_id = v.video_id GROUP BY v.video_id

guest_leaderboard.title: Guest Leaderboard
guest_leaderboard.description: Guest stats: who talked the most, longest conversations
guest_leaderboard.sql: SELECT u.video_id, u.speaker, COUNT(*) as utterances, CAST(SUM(length(u.text))/5 AS INTEGER) as est_words, CAST((MAX(u.end_sec) - MIN(u.start_sec))/60 AS INTEGER) as duration_min, printf('%d:%02d:%02d', CAST(MIN(u.start_sec)/3600 AS INT), CAST((MIN(u.start_sec)%3600)/60 AS INT), CAST(MIN(u.start_sec)%60 AS INT)) as start_time FROM utterances u WHERE u.speaker != 'parker' GROUP BY u.video_id, u.speaker ORDER BY utterances DESC

search_transcript.title: Search Transcripts
search_transcript.sql: SELECT u.video_id, u.speaker, u.chapter, printf('%d:%02d:%02d', CAST(u.start_sec/3600 AS INT), CAST((u.start_sec%3600)/60 AS INT), CAST(u.start_sec%60 AS INT)) as timestamp, u.text, 'https://youtu.be/' || u.video_id || '?t=' || CAST(u.start_sec AS INT) as youtube_link FROM utterances u JOIN utterances_fts fts ON u.id = fts.rowid WHERE utterances_fts MATCH :query ORDER BY rank LIMIT 50

epstein_tracker.title: Epstein Mentions
epstein_tracker.description: Every mention of Epstein across all streams
epstein_tracker.sql: SELECT u.video_id, u.speaker, u.chapter, printf('%d:%02d:%02d', CAST(u.start_sec/3600 AS INT), CAST((u.start_sec%3600)/60 AS INT), CAST(u.start_sec%60 AS INT)) as timestamp, u.text, 'https://youtu.be/' || u.video_id || '?t=' || CAST(u.start_sec AS INT) as youtube_link FROM utterances u WHERE lower(u.text) LIKE '%epstein%' ORDER BY u.video_id, u.start_sec
